field_checks.summary: Final activity coverage enumerates the expected 130 source rows/cells: 76 from Supplementary Data 3, 36 from Supplementary Data 4, and 18 from Supplementary Data 10. Values match source cells, but the nine Supplementary Data 10 column E MIC records preserve an unresolved strain-label conflict incorrectly: the workbook header/raw label says S. aureus ATCC 25923, while target_strain_or_isolate is ATCC 29213 and the source_conflicts metadata also records the source label as ATCC 29213.

The database layer correctly keeps all four DBAASP fallback machine rows as unresolved_record because linked authoritative article, assay, sequence, and literature rows are absent. Candidate source identities and residue counts for p15, p17, and p20 are source-located, but authoritative DBAASP ingest is not ready and must remain excluded from portal/RC2 release.

All current paper final JSON records were reviewed, and the packet final mirror was reviewed. Paper final has five JSON records; packet final has the same five byte-identical files plus a byte-identical mechanism_evidence alias for mechanism_ontology_record. Final counts are 130 activity rows, 126 toxicity rows, 4 database audits, 4 mechanism claims, 0 rework targets, and live packet open rework count 0.

The mechanism final keeps one direct PI/permeability mechanism claim and keeps AlphaFold/PepFold structure, physicochemical rationale, and MIC phenotype evidence in computational_only, inferred_mechanism, and phenotype_supported classes. Direct assay types are present only for the direct PI claim.

Primary XML/PDF identity matches PMC12125351, PMID 40447738, DOI 10.1038/s42003-025-08282-7, and the AMPGen title. Source-local peptide identities in Supplementary Data 3/4 were checked separately from non-authoritative DBAASP fallback rows; every plain peptide sequence with a sequence_length in current finals has exact residue-count agreement.

Primary XML/PDF/supplement locators are generally packet-resolvable and workbook activity/toxicity values are source-faithful. The blocking defect is confined to Supplementary Data 10 column E conflict metadata: nine source_conflicts use a non-indexed column locator and record the source label as ATCC 29213 even though the source workbook header/raw label is ATCC 25923.

No fallback DBAASP machine row is promoted to source_verified or authoritative ingest; authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false. Recursive source-authority boundaries are otherwise preserved: final source locator fields do not depend on worker analysis/final artifacts for scientific support, and the strict audit explicitly limits the result to paper-level evidence, not authoritative DBAASP release.

The database caution is preserved correctly, but the activity final does not accurately preserve the Supplementary Data 10 column E strain conflict. The raw label says ATCC 25923 while assigned/value-provenance strain is ATCC 29213, yet source_conflicts.source_label_value and source_reported_target_strain_or_isolate also say ATCC 29213; this reports a conflict without the conflicting source value.

All staged supplements were inspected: MOESM1 PDF, MOESM2 XLSX, MOESM3 PDF, and MOESM4 reporting-summary PDF. The packet extracted 12 workbook sheets, 1042 nonempty rows, 15396 nonempty cells, 22 supplementary text pages, no archive members, and no extraction errors.

Toxicity/selectivity evidence is source-reviewed and complete for final rows: 18 log10 CC50/HC50 rows from Supplementary Data 10, 54 hemolysis concentration-series rows from Supplementary Data 11, and 54 IEC-6 cell-viability rows from Supplementary Data 12. Method conditions match XML methods: cytotoxicity 24 h and hemolysis 1 h; multi-cell series are preserved without unsupported normalization.

blocking_findings.reason: Nine final activity records for Supplementary Data 10 column E are not field-level source-reviewable as currently represented. The source workbook header/raw_endpoint_label says log10(MIC against S. aureus ATCC 25923[μg/mL]), while the final target_strain_or_isolate is ATCC 29213. A conflict could be acceptable if explicitly preserved, but the final source_conflicts.source_label_value and source_reported_target_strain_or_isolate both say ATCC 29213, omitting the actual source header value ATCC 25923. The same conflict metadata uses supp:...:column=E, which is not a packet locator in locator_index. This is a material target/strain and locator-integrity defect despite row-count and value-cell coverage.
required_actions: Repair all nine Supplementary Data 10 column E MIC activity records so the actual workbook header/source label ATCC 25923 is explicitly preserved in source_reported_target_strain_or_isolate or source_conflicts.source_label_value, while any ATCC 29213 assignment remains clearly marked as value-provenance interpretation with source basis.

Replace non-indexed source_label_locator values such as supp:42003_2025_8282_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx:sheet=Supplementary Data 10:column=E with resolvable packet locators, preferably the header cell supp:42003_2025_8282_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx:sheet=Supplementary Data 10:row=2:cell=E2, or add and validate column-level locators in locator_index.
Regenerate paper and packet activity_toxicity_evidence.json mirrors and have worker-6 re-adjudicate the repaired conflict rather than accepting the existing conflict metadata.
acceptance_checks: Python check over final activity_toxicity_evidence.json: every source_locator containing Supplementary Data 10:row=3..11:cell=E has raw_endpoint_label containing ATCC 25923 and conflict metadata containing both ATCC 25923 and ATCC 29213 when target_strain_or_isolate is ATCC 29213.

Python locator check: every source_label_locator and supporting_source_locators value in the nine affected rows resolves in packets/PMC12125351/locators/locator_index.json or to an explicitly indexed XML/PDF/database locator; no supp:...:column=E unresolved locator remains.

Python source-cell check: final activity count remains 130, toxicity count remains 126, all affected raw_value entries exactly equal the workbook cells in Supplementary Data 10 column E, and paper/packet final mirrors are byte-identical after repair.
Rerun the strict semantic and publication gates without allow flags and confirm no activity/source-conflict issue remains for PMC12125351.

cautions.summary: Local authoritative APD6/DBAASP/DRAMP linked rows are absent. The current final correctly keeps four fallback machine rows as unresolved_record and sets authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready=false; this preserves the release boundary but prevents authoritative DBAASP/portal/RC2 ingest.

The packet final contains an extra mechanism_evidence.json compatibility alias. It is byte-identical to the paper mechanism_ontology_record.json according to independent hash comparison and worker6 mirror validation, so it is not a blocking mirror-count defect.
